move.w d7,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   IClose
 bcs    failed

 lea    okmsg(pc),a0
 move.l #okmsglen,d1
 move.w #STDOUT,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   IWrite

* Error path. Carry SET means the call failed and d1.w holds the code.
 lea    missing(pc),a0
 moveq  #READ,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   IOpen
 bcc    unexpected       succeeding here is itself the failure
 move.w d1,d6            save the code before anything else clobbers d1

 lea    experr(pc),a0
 move.l #experrlen,d1
 move.w #STDOUT,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   IWrite

* F$PErr(d0.w=error-message file path, 0=none; d1.w=error code)
 move.w d6,d1
 moveq  #0,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   FPErr

 moveq  #0,d1
 trap   #0
 dc.w   FExit

unexpected
 lea    unexpmsg(pc),a0
 move.l #unexplen,d1
 move.w #STDOUT,d0
 trap   #0
 dc.w   IWrite
 moveq  #1,d1
 trap   #0
 dc.w   F
